profile.headline: Software Developer @ IBM
profile.summary: I'm a Software Engineer at IBM and a recent Carnegie Mellon University graduate with a B.S. in Electrical and Computer Engineering. I enjoy building software, solving challenging problems, and learning new technologies. I'm especially interested in backend development, AI, and cloud technologies, and I'm always looking for opportunities to grow as an engineer while creating meaningful solutions.

positions.title: Generative AI Technical Advisor Intern
positions.description:
• Trained and evaluated advanced large language models for competitive programming and mathematical reasoning tasks.  
• Supported production-scale AI experiments and model assessments to enhance AI capabilities.  
• Devised benchmarks and evaluation protocols to measure model accuracy, efficiency, and reliability.
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · C/C++ · Data Analysis · JSON · Large Language Models (LLM)

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Developed a scalable computer vision pipeline integrating automated annotation with CLIP & GroundingDINO, ensuring high-quality training data.  
• Created end-to-end YOLO model training workflows in Python, optimized for GPU performance.  
• Deployed containerized REST APIs to facilitate seamless integration of machine learning models.  
• Implemented monitoring and observability solutions using Prometheus and Grafana to enhance system reliability.
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · Machine Learning · FastAPI · PromQL · Docker

positions.title: Research Engineer Intern @ NEXT Lab
positions.description:
https://www.nextlab.group/
- Utilized MATLAB and ray tracing software to simulate and optimize optical paths in mixed reality systems, enhancing Near-Eye Display clarity and reducing image distortion. 
- Developed Python scripts for automating data analysis and Fourier optics calculations, streamlining evaluation of system efficiency and minimizing light leakage.
positions.insights: Skills: Electrical Design · MATLAB · Computer Simulations · Electrical Products

positions.title: Carnegie Mellon University, Undergraduate Research
positions.description: Project: Multi-Agent Path Planning: Subdimensional Expansion and Operations
